calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, w.status, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
       MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_sale,
       SUM(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_order_row
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id = 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_code='WB')
  AND ((d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 26 AND 40) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 26 AND 40))
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'sales' AS tbl, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines,
       MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-14' AND DATE '2026-02-08'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), 0
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-14' AND DATE '2026-02-08'

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS c FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-14' AND DATE '2026-02-08'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.sale_ts_utc
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS c FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-14' AND DATE '2026-02-08'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS dup_rows, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = r.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND r.store_id <> 999
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.region, m.net_sales, c.ctrl_net, m.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS gap
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_year, region)
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ly.region, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
       'FY2024/25' AS comparison_fiscal_year, ROUND(py.net_sales, 2) AS comparison_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ly.net_sales / py.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM q3 ly JOIN q3 py ON py.region = ly.region AND py.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY CASE ly.region WHEN 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ly.region
